name: dh-recovery-ads
look: Editorial, photoreal, real environment with depth and context. Real domestic or gym light, honest surfaces, a sense of place. Not a studio packshot on slate.

jobs.line: the shoulder never fully came back
jobs.scene: A roll of white athletic tape, partly used with the loose end trailing, on a worn wooden bench in an ordinary home gym. Late afternoon light through a window. The vial stands beside it, in focus.

jobs.line: it healed. it just healed wrong.
jobs.scene: A bone-white ceramic bowl on a kitchen counter, cleanly broken and rejoined slightly out of true so the seam does not line up, a thin gold line along the join. The vial stands behind it, softly out of focus.
